hooks.name: Protect Deterministic Verifier
hooks.description: Ensures the evidence verifier stays deterministic with no LLM calls — the core architectural invariant

action.prompt: If modifying backend/services/evidence_verifier.py, ensure NO LLM or model calls are introduced. This file must remain fully deterministic — all verification decisions must be rule-based code only. The evidence verifier is the core trust gate and must never delegate decisions to an AI model. Check for: imports of model_router, call_model, openai, or any async model calls.
